name: Sanjou Tsukine
source: Tsukine is a third-year student and the president of the student council and the representative of the dormitory for girls. Tsukine has common sense but no common knowledge, Boys are attracted to Tsukine because of Tsukine's smile. In the school, all the students respect Tsukine and all the teachers trust Tsukine. Tsukine is calm and friendly and has mercy on anybody and the spirit of self-sacrifice. On the other hand Tsukine is ditzy so that rarely makes mistakes no one will do.
